listing.name: Tecmo's Deception: Invitation to Darkness (Deception-recomp)
listing.summary: Upstream route: Upstream WindowsZIP/setup orLinuxAppImage asks for exact supported disc then builds game locally on first start. Laterstarts reuse prepared build; development .NET10SDK requirement is separate from packaged route. Limits: Upstream only: Upstream says playable and explicitly lacks a verified full playthrough. First-start local compilation and disc validation are separate from gameplay qualification. First launch compiles from own disc; .NET 10 SDK required for source build. Upstream says playable, full playthrough unverified. Fork of verdite2 is framework reuse, not same game. Upstream platforms: Windows x64 ZIP/setup and Linux x86-64 AppImage. .NET 10 SDK is documented for source builds. Original data: PS1 Tecmo Deception Invitation to Darkness NTSC-U SLUS-00340 CUE/BIN or CHD v5. Exact source revision/hash and BIOS/firmware requirements not stated above remain Unknown in this review. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
